design: An adult human dark priestess adversary, stylized same proportions as female player clerics. Pale angular face, narrow violet eyes and arched haughty brows, long straight black hair in one braid, a restrained dark brass brow circlet. Modest high-neck deep-purple/black medieval robes with antique gold trim, covered shoulders and sleeves, leather belt, gloves and boots. Holds ONE SHORT dark iron ceremonial scepter with a crescent-shaped top, held beside her waist and NEVER rising above her head in idle; keeps it in all16poses. Her free hand makes sharp ritual casting gestures. A confident spiteful comic fantasy villain, not cute or sensual. Idle fixed feet and breathing/blink, hurt recoils and scowls, attack winds free hand back then thrusts palm/scepter toward RIGHT as if casting with no detached effects, dodge ducks/leans back retaining scepter. Generous transparent cell margins.
prompt:
Create a BRAND NEW production sprite sheet for a medieval fantasy RPG enemy: Sacerdotisa Oscura (sacerdotisa_oscura). Reference image ONE defines ONLY the game's established player-character ART STYLE, not the subject or poses. Reference image TWO defines ONLY the 4-by-4 GRID and its generous padding: match its small figure size relative to the empty cells, never copy its orc subject.  Match its polished hand-painted chibi JRPG fantasy aesthetic, crisp dark outlines, detailed textured materials, warm highlights, soft volumetric shading, readable small-scale silhouette. ART DIRECTION: stylized 2D cartoon fantasy RPG ADVERSARY, lively exaggerated acting and bold simplified shapes, mischievous and hostile like a dungeon troublemaker. Fun to fight, not adorable, not a friendly pet or baby mascot. Medium-size angular eyes, pointed brows, toothy crooked smirk. NO giant sparkling puppy eyes, NO blush, NO rosy cheeks, NO tiny sweet smile, NO cuddly baby proportions. Avoid grimdark photorealism, horror and gore as well. Use readable hand-painted/cel-shaded surfaces and confident outlines matching the player reference. EXACT LAYOUT: FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows, exactly SIXTEEN separate complete poses of this SAME creature. Square 1:1 sprite-sheet composition. No labels, grid lines or text. Transparent empty background. Every subject entirely within its own equal cell, generous empty padding between figures. Make each entire creature INCLUDING weapons/tail/wings occupy at most 70% of its cell WIDTH and 60% HEIGHT, with wide transparent margins on all four sides. No overlap between cells, no cropped horns, tails, wings or weapons.
ROW 1 (top): IDLE four subtly different frames, stable feet/root on an identical baseline and identical horizontal coordinate within each cell; tiny breathing, subtle blink, no side-to-side movement, no walking.
ROW 2 (middle): HURT four frames, neutral alert, flinch from a blow, strongest recoil, recovering; no blood, no impact star, no floating effects.
ROW 3: ATTACK four frames, anticipation, wind-up, decisive species-appropriate strike toward the RIGHT, recovery. A clear real action change, never four copies.
If carrying equipment, the same weapon must remain HELD visibly in ALL 16 frames, including hurt and dodge; never vanish, drop or swap it. All sixteen figures SAME identity, costume, equipment, colors, body size and camera scale. Side-view three-quarter camera facing RIGHT, matching the player reference. For this creature keep its natural anatomy, not a humanoid costume unless specified. Anchor the support point consistently in all cells, stable idle. ROW 4 (bottom): DODGE four frames, alert preparation, evasive duck or sidestep/backward lean appropriate to the species, lowest evasive pose, return to guard. Distinct from hurt and attack. No ghost copies or motion streaks.
Keep every frame FULL BODY and the same zoom. Transparent background with real alpha, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadows, no captions, no frame borders, no UI. This is high-detail NEW art, not enlarged old pixel art.
